newsitem.title: ISRAEL: SOCCER-SWEDEN BEAT ISRAEL 1-0 IN SOCCER FRIENDLY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SWEDEN BEAT ISRAEL 1-0 IN SOCCER FRIENDLY.

text.p: Sweden beat Israel 1-0 in an international soccer friendly here on Wednesday.

Israel: 1-Rafi Cohen; 2-Felix Halfon, 3-Moshe Glam (14-Alon Hazan 45th minute), 4-Amir Shelah, 5-Arik Bennado, 6-Nir Klinger, 7-Alon Mizrahi (19-Shai Holtzman 75th), 8-Yossi Abuksis (15-Guy Yitzhak 76th), 9-Ronnie Rosenthal, 10-Ran Ben-Shimon, 11-Eli Ohana

Sweden: 1-Thomas Ravelli (12-Magnus Hedman 45th); 2-Roland Nilsson, 3-Christian Carlsson, 4-Andreas Jacobsson, 5-Teddy Lucic (15-Niclas Alexandersson 72nd), 6-Johan Mjallby, 7-Hakan Mild, 8-Anders Andersson, 9-Andreas Andersson, 10-Kennet Andersson (Mathias Svensson 61st), 11-Jesper Blomqvist
